extensionDescription.message: Download routes and collections with your chosen export settings in your normal browser session.

instructions.message: Download one route or an entire collection using your normal Plotaroute browser session.

downloading.message: Waiting for the download to finish…

openRoute.message: Open an individual Plotaroute route, rather than a collection.

viewerUnavailable.message: The route viewer is unavailable. Check that the map loads normally.

routeNotReady.message: The route has not loaded. Wait until its track is visible and try again.

downloadUnavailable.message: The download dialog could not be opened. Check for a site access check or cookie dialog.

settingsUnavailable.message: The requested download settings are unavailable. Check your selected format and options.

downloadInterrupted.message: The browser interrupted the download. Check its Downloads list.

downloadTimeout.message: No completed download was detected within one minute. Check the page and the browser Downloads list.

downloadPromptHint.message: For unattended downloads, turn off “Ask where to save each file” in browser download settings. Completed files are remembered.

collectionComplete.message: Collection complete. Metadata export saved alongside your downloaded files.

pauseRequested.message: Pause requested; the current download will finish first.

invalidCollection.message: Enter a valid Plotaroute collection ID or URL.

collectionChanged.message: Collection membership changed. The saved job was kept; export it before starting a new collection.

openPlotaroute.message: Open https://www.plotaroute.com in this tab before starting.

noSavedCollection.message: No matching collection progress is saved.

resumeFirst.message: Resume or finish the saved collection before starting another.

pendingDownload.message: A previous download is still in progress. Finish or cancel it in the browser, then resume.

navigationTimeout.message: The route page did not finish loading. Progress is saved; check the tab and resume.
